label: Learn ByteChef by doing
description: New to ByteChef? This simple workflow is the perfect way to get started. In just a few minutes, you’ll build your first automation: it fetches a random quote from the internet and logs it, and you run it with one click.

tasks.description: Fetches a random quote from dummyjson.com as JSON. Open its output after a run to see the fields, such as quote and author, that later steps can use as data pills.
tasks.label: Get a random quote
tasks.name: httpClient_1

tasks.description: Writes the quote text from the previous step to the execution log, using the ${httpClient_1.quote} data pill.
tasks.label: Log the quote
tasks.name: logger_1
